commit.subject: conductor: harden check-tests handoff
commit.body:
Require check-tests verdicts to agree with findings, replace findings payloads atomically so planted symlinks are not followed, centralize write-path detection, and document the practiced read-job slots. Restore the frozen plan wire required by both named task suites after the intervening dev merge changed it.
